subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the fourteen official action updates, including the credential-bearing token, registry, and Codex actions, be accepted together on the current workflow security boundary?
rationale: Automated checks can validate workflow syntax and exercised paths, but they cannot decide whether the reviewed upstream code changes are acceptable recipients of OpenClaw's production credentials and release authority.

options.title: Approve after gates
options.body: Confirm official release provenance for every SHA and merge the grouped update after all current-head security and automation checks pass.

options.title: Split sensitive pins
options.body: Separate create-github-app-token, docker/login-action, and openai/codex-action into narrower PRs if maintainers want independent credential-boundary review.

recommendation.title: Approve after gates
recommendation.body: Confirm official release provenance for every SHA and merge the grouped update after all current-head security and automation checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person most directly to the release and Docker automation carrying the highest-impact credentials in this update.
